jobs.occupation: Application Excellence Manager - Chocolate and Confectionary
jobs.description:
**Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food — we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about **Making Better Happen™.

****AAK Location

**This role will be based at our site in Aarhus.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Global Application Excellence Manager to join AAK’s Applied Innovation organisation and serve as one of our global technical authorities within Chocolate & Confectionery Fats (CCF). Combining deep expertise in confectionery formulation, fat functionality and processing with innovation and industry knowledge, you will help strengthen AAK’s position as The Co-Development Company.

In this role, you will expand and strengthen AAK’s application knowledge by developing and validating customer-relevant proof points, leading lower-complexity product development projects and supporting Scientists on medium- and long-term innovation programmes. You will translate technical expertise into practical customer solutions that demonstrate the value of AAK’s portfolio.

Working alongside our other Global Application Excellence Manager – Chocolate & Confectionery, you will connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams, global functions and external industry stakeholders. You will help ensure knowledge and expertise are shared across regions, while identifying customer needs and market opportunities that can be translated into differentiated solutions and future innovation.

As a global technical reference point, you will support regional teams through technical guidance, training, customer projects and troubleshooting. You will also contribute to the development of AAK’s Confectionery Centre of Excellence and Customer Innovation Network, helping build capabilities and consistent application expertise across the organisation.

**Responsibilities

**

• Act as a global subject matter expert in Chocolate & Confectionery applications, with deep knowledge of CCF formulation, fat functionality, processing technologies and ingredient interactions.

• Connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams and global technical functions to strengthen knowledge sharing and ensure expertise is effectively leveraged across AAK.

• Design, develop and validate compelling application proof points that demonstrate customer value and differentiate AAK’s solutions.

• Lead lower-complexity product development projects while supporting Scientists on more complex, medium- and long-term innovation programmes.

• Translate new products and technologies into customer demonstrations, application evidence, technical documentation and materials that support successful commercialisation.

• Support regional teams with complex application and processing challenges through troubleshooting, technical guidance, customer workshops, factory trials and evaluations.

• Strengthen the Confectionery Centre of Excellence by developing application methods, evaluation protocols, best practices, technical tools and knowledge resources.

• Deliver AAK Academy training and technical learning programmes while supporting the development of the CCF Customer Innovation Network and wider technical capabilities.

• Analyse customer innovation projects and market developments to identify recurring needs, application gaps, future proof points and opportunities for new product development.

• Represent AAK within the wider confectionery ecosystem through relationships with suppliers, equipment manufacturers and industry experts, while supporting technology scouting and competitive benchmarking.

• Contribute to intellectual property activities, including technical evidence, application validation and competitive differentiation where relevant.

**About You

**

• MSc or PhD in Food Science, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline.

• 8–10+ years of relevant industry experience within chocolate, confectionery, specialty fats or related food applications.

• Recognised expertise in Chocolate & Confectionery Fats, including formulation, fat functionality, ingredient interactions and processing technologies across applications such as chocolate, compounds, fillings, spreads and caramel.

• Proven experience in application development, product development, scale-up, customer trials and commercialisation.

• Ability to translate customer needs, market trends and technical knowledge into differentiated application solutions and compelling customer value.

• Experience working across global, cross-functional organisations, connecting technical experts and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Strong troubleshooting, process optimisation and communication skills, with a passion for knowledge sharing, capability building and mentoring.

• Experience with innovation processes, technology scouting, competitive benchmarking or intellectual property activities is an advantage; fluent in English and willing to travel internationally.

**In return AAK offers

**

• Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.

• In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.

• AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths.

• You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach.

• Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

**Contact and information

**For further information about the position, please contact Emily Lumb, Talent Acquisition Specialist: emily.lumb@aak.com

**About AAK

**Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable.

At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and more than 20 production facilities worldwide. Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

AAK is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

Location: Høje-Taastrup

Your impact begins here

Are you an experienced analytical scientist who wants to help bring new medicines to market? Join Novo and take scientific ownership of analytical activities for synthetic APIs, working with Contract Manufacturing Organisations (CMOs) worldwide.

You will use your analytical and GMP expertise to support products from late-stage development through commercial supply. You will also help shape the processes and ways of working in our growing Synthetic Analytical MSAT department.

Submit your application today!

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, you have:

• A master’s degree or higher in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related scientific discipline.

• At least five years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical analytical science.

• Practical experience working in a GMP-regulated environment, such as a QC laboratory.

• Strong knowledge of GMP, relevant ICH guidelines and pharmaceutical regulatory requirements.

• Experience with deviations, change control, out-of-specification investigations and analytical method validation.

• Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

You bring sound scientific judgement and communicate complex analytical topics clearly to different stakeholders. You enjoy working collaboratively, take ownership of your responsibilities and maintain a strong focus on quality. You are comfortable setting direction when processes are still developing and building effective relationships with colleagues and external partners.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience with late-stage pharmaceutical development and synthetic APIs, including small molecules or peptides.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Analytical Scientist, you will provide scientific and GMP expertise to CMOs and internal stakeholders. You will help ensure that robust and efficient analytical methods and programmes are established at our manufacturing partners and maintained throughout the product lifecycle. You will also lead analytical contributions to regulatory submissions.

• Act as the scientific lead for analytical activities, providing expertise to CMOs and internal stakeholders.

• Lead analytical activities and contributions to regulatory submissions from late-stage development through the commercial lifecycle.

• Lead the transfer and implementation of analytical methods between Novo and external partners.

• Author and review analytical documentation, including SOPs, protocols, reports and method transfer plans.

• Develop and improve internal processes and SOPs to support consistent and efficient ways of working.

Who you’ll work with

You will work alongside analytical specialists and project managers in a team that encourages open discussion, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem-solving. As our manufacturing partners are based worldwide, the role includes some international travel (<14 days a year) and occasional meetings across time zones.

What you can expect here

In this growing area, you will have the opportunity to shape analytical processes and ways of working. You will use your experience and scientific judgement to set direction, resolve analytical challenges and support the transition from development to commercial supply. A strong understanding of GMP will help you establish robust processes that support product approval and reliable commercial manufacturing.

As Supply Chain Project Manager, you will step straight into live initiatives where supply chain, IT, data and regulatory requirements meet. You will drive regulatory, logistics and master data projects with global reach, turning complex requirements into clear decisions and timely delivery. Your work will help digitalise and strengthen end-to-end supply chain processes, so the treatments people rely on keep moving through a setup that is compliant, connected and ready for what comes next.

We are hiring two Project Managers, one for each of our two teams.

What you’ll bring

You bring a hands-on approach, structure and strong stakeholder collaboration skills.

We are looking for:

• Hands-on supply chain experience in logistics processes or master data. Practical experience matters more to us than theoretical knowledge.

• Project management experience, ideally 5+ years. Pharma experience is not required.

• The ability to work with IT systems, or to learn the basics quickly, with an understanding of logistics processes and/or master data.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to make complex topics simple.

• A proactive mindset. You are comfortable questioning assumptions and bringing structure to ambiguous tasks.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience with Serialisation or UDI (Unique Device Identification).

• Experience with warehouse management.

• Exposure to regulatory compliance projects.

What you’ll do

You will join ongoing work and help the team move high-impact deliverables forward with global stakeholders.

You will:

• Drive and deliver supply chain and regulatory implementation projects, keeping work aligned and on time.

• Lead third-party logistics (3PL) implementations within Novo’s logistics setup, from building the business case to running Steering Committees and facilitating decisions.

• Translate technical and process-heavy information into clear messages that support structured decision-making.

• Support master data activities across logistics, product and outbound flows, making sure the right data is understood and implemented correctly.

• Work closely with IT on integrations, system requirements and data-related tasks.

• Coordinate stakeholders globally, creating clarity on what is “need to have” versus “nice to have” and enabling smooth end-to-end process flows.

Who you’ll work with

You will join either the Serialisation & UDI team or the Improvement & Implementations team within Global Logistic and Distribution. Each team has 10+ colleagues, known for being helpful and fun to work with, and works across global supply chain functions, affiliates, external warehouses and production sites.

The teams are based in Høje-Taastrup and work closely with IT colleagues in Ballerup. Together, you will connect business needs, system requirements and data, helping partners agree on priorities and move projects from analysis to implementation.

What you can expect here

You will work across supply chain, IT and regulatory topics, which gives you a broad view of how logistics and data connect across the value chain. You will build new skills on the job alongside experienced colleagues, and you will be trusted to take ownership, make your voice heard and bring structure where it is needed.

The work moves at pace and has global reach. You will be part of a team that values clarity, collaboration and practical progress.

What we offer

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

• A good communicator with strong interpersonal skills

• A good listener with ability to digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions

• A collaborative team player who enjoys collaborating with others

• Experience with quality assurance is an advantage

• Experience from a logistics or transport-oriented company is an advantage

Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you!

Your position

In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg, Aarhus or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.

“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS

• Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure

• Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443

• Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations

• Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities

• Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration

• Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.

Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.

Your profile & qualifications

You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position

• A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders

• The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English

• Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage

If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.

**Service Desk Technician - Network

**Would you like to work hands-on with B2B network operations and help keep critical digital infrastructure running? In this role, you will take ownership of customer cases, troubleshoot network-related issues and make sure the right actions are taken when services are affected.

**What You Need To Succeed

**

• Relevant education in IT/ networking.

• Experience working with network products and a good understanding of network structures.

• Professional communication skills in both Danish and English.

• Experience working in a structured way with operational cases, where you prioritise according to SLAs and business criticality.

**About The Role And The Team

**You will join a specialised team supporting GlobalConnect’s B2B customers within network and security services. Based primarily at our Copenhagen office, you will work closely with colleagues to solve incidents, share knowledge and ensure effective handovers.

The role combines technical troubleshooting with customer communication. You will be responsible for keeping cases moving from the first contact through follow-up, resolution or the correct handover.

The role follows a planned 24/7 shift rotation with a mix of daytime, evening and night shift****s, including evening shifts around 15–23 and night shifts around 23–07. Weekend shifts are also part of the rotation.

The schedule is planned in advance and includes longer periods of consecutive days off, including full weeks off at certain points in the rotation. This gives you a combination of varied working hours and longer stretches of time away from work.

**What You’ll Be Working On

**

• Receive and handle B2B customer enquiries by phone and through our systems.

• Take ownership of cases and prioritise them according to severity, SLAs, escalations and business criticality.

• Troubleshoot and work proactively with incidents and alarms related to network and security products.

• Follow up with customers and suppliers in accordance with agreed SLAs.

• Ensure clear handovers between shifts, colleagues and departments.
